Every Lakhasa ship is named for the relative that taught the owner the tricks of the spacer trade. Today, the Lakhasa name is well known in ports across the galaxy. Some beings have tried to falsely claim membership, only to be visited by the larger and more temperamental members of the family. The Lakhasa Caravan knows that all it ever has for certain is its good name, and it protects that name vigorously.
